text:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — ran the docs-scanner on /kb/runtime and it flagged a couple small things that are breaking search/sidebar links. Anyone on runtime nav today?
Ethan: I touched that nav last week, I can take ownership for a quick tidy.
Priya: Thanks — can you paste the exact scanner output so I know what to expect?
Docs Scanner: docs-scanner v2.1 results (summary):
```
/kb/runtime/serving.md: missing frontmatter key 'category' -> search index skip
/kb/runtime/latency.md: internal link to /faq/cache -> 404 (target moved)
/kb/runtime/index.md: nav slug 'runtime' != sidebar entry 'runtime-guide' -> mismatch causes sidebar 404 from some pages
```
Aisha: exact. The serving.md missing category causes it to be excluded from some index pages. latency.md link should point to /kb/faq/cache not /faq/cache (legacy path).
Ethan: repro locally with `yarn docs:link-check` — I see the same 3 issues. I'll open a small PR: branch docs/runtime-nav-tidy, will fix slug, update the internal link, and add frontmatter.
CI Bot: link-check job failed on PR docs/runtime-nav-tidy — 2 broken links (latency.md -> /faq/cache, index.md -> sidebar mismatch).
Ethan: plan: 1) add `category: runtime` to serving.md frontmatter, 2) sed the latency internal path to `/kb/faq/cache`, 3) rename slug in index.md to `runtime-guide` to match sidebar. I'll include a short changelog entry and a note in the PR description.
Priya: I can review after your PR is up. If tests are green I'll merge. If you want faster merge, add me as reviewer and mark `urgent/doc-fix`. :thumbsup:
Aisha: small ask — please also add `owner: docs` to serving.md frontmatter so future scans can assign it automatically.
Ethan: will do. Also adding a one-line unit in the PR description: "fix: runtime nav/search regressions (category, link, slug)". ETA ~1h.
Docs Scanner: quick helpful snippet to reproduce:
```bash
git checkout -b docs/runtime-nav-tidy
yarn docs:link-check --path kb/runtime || true
# confirm fixes locally, then push and open PR
```
Priya: perfect. Ping me on the PR and I'll take a look around 15:00 PT.
Ethan: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12345 with the three small commits. CC @Priya.
CI Bot: PR 12345 — link-check passed, build passed.
Priya: Reviewing now. Small nit: latency.md link change is good but update the broken anchor (cache#eviction) to `#eviction-policy`.
Ethan: done, pushed a patch commit. CI rerunning.
CI Bot: PR 12345 — all checks green.
Priya: LGTM. Merging. :shipit:
Aisha: thank you both — that should make the periodic scans happier and reduce noise.
Ethan: no problem, happy to keep the runtime nav tidy.
Docs Scanner: next scheduled scan in 24h; will report back if anything else pops up.
